security_privacy_cost_impact: Narrows client reach: a member of a workspace in access_blocked, purge_queued, held, purging, verify or deleted is refused by every family that calls the membership helpers, for reads and writes, and by the five 010 policies 171 rewrites; notifications (PII-2) included. app_authz gains SELECT on two columns of app.workspaces and one policy no wider than authenticated's own, calling no helper; its reach stays the caller's own rows. No grant to a client role, no secret, no new dependency. The helper now joins app.workspaces on its key: one sample 0.066 ms at the 0.2 scale against a 2 ms budget.
migration_and_data_impact: One forward migration, 171_workspace_lifecycle_visibility.sql, declared not applied to the provisioned instance (it needs 011). 010 and 011 are not edited; 011's and 021's apply-time blocks are superseded with final-state replacements. No data changes. Drifts were appended to 140_audit.sql for one round each and restored byte for byte. open_blockers[198] is added at the end of the list; the amendment path list grows from two to three, so the 33 line pins in audit-coverage-map.json move +1.
compatibility_impact: Tests stay 685 (no test added or renamed); foundation-contract's assertion floor 1119 -> 1121 in scripts/test-suite-contract.mjs; evidence/VERIFICATION.md is not amended. Four catalog-rule probe digests move (permissive policy, security definer, pinned grant, policy set). The isolation runner gains three optional case fields (before, ownerFirst, a connection-role witness); existing cases are unchanged.
